newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Telecom plans IDD discounts in December.
newsitem.headline: HK Telecom plans IDD discounts in December.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd is offering discounts on its long-distance international calls to eligible customers in December.
The scheme is still awaiting necessary government approval, a spokeswoman for Hongkong Telecom said.
In an advertisment in some local newspapers, Hongkong Telecom urged customers to register to join a Christmas price reduction scheme on International Direct Dail (IDD) calls.
Registered customers would get as much as 50 percent off their long-distance calls in December if their phone bills were HK$1,000 in excess of their November accounts.
"The excess portion will get a 50 percent discount," it said.
A smaller discount of 20 percent will be offered to customers whose IDD bills were at least HK$100 more in December than November, the advertisment said.
